query:
INSERT INTO settings (
                        key,
                        value,
                        user_id,
                        updated_at
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        'aria2_global_options',
                        ?,
                        ?,
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT(key, user_id) DO UPDATE
                    SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
